verdict.rationale: Pulley is a cap-table and equity-management SaaS that holds sensitive company and stakeholder data, so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, deletion controls, or data-purge capabilities. Adjacent features such as cap table export, merging duplicate stakeholders, and terminating stakeholder vesting are not retention or deletion controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
